subject: compiler:mwcc-gc-1.2.5
value:
THE INVERSE COPY-FORM DIRECTION IS NOW SERVED, AND THE CENSUS THAT JUSTIFIED BUILDING IT ALSO SHOWS THAT THE DIRECTION WAS NEVER THE BINDING CONSTRAINT - THE RECOLOR COMPOSITION IS, BY THIRTEEN TO ONE. This bounds claim.law.DC_copy-form-class-is-directional-and-its-inverse-population-is-unserved.20260901.v1, which is correct in everything it states.

WHAT SHIPPED. equivalent_copy_form now accepts `dominating_def_inverse` and `dominating_def_inverse_across_calls`: ours is the copy `rD <- rS`, the target is `li rD,K`, and the obligation is that OUR rS holds K at the site. It is the mirror image of `dominating_def` and is discharged by the SAME backward scan over the SAME stream - ours. THE WORK ORDER FOR THIS LANE SPECIFIED THE SCAN SHOULD RUN ON THE TARGET STREAM; THAT IS WRONG AND WAS NOT DONE. The patched bytes execute in OUR object, so the fact needed is about OUR rS; a proof about the target's registers says nothing about the object being patched. Separately named modes, not a widening, so no existing rule can drift onto the opposite arrow - pinned by three tests. An rS of r0 is refused outright, preserving the r0 encoding asymmetry the class rests on.

THE CENSUS, and it is the part to carry forward. Over 2835 equal-size paired functions, read from RAW .postprocess/body output with the five shipped composed rules as canaries (all five FOUND - a scanner without a canary lies), every differing word classified: other 9057, regfield 7859, inv_rc 47, fwd_rc 44, fwd 5, inv 2. Read the arrows. The two PURE form classes that need no renaming - `fwd` (5) and `inv` (2) - total SEVEN sites image-wide. The two classes where the form change is accompanied by a DESTINATION MISMATCH - `fwd_rc` (44) and `inv_rc` (47) - total NINETY-ONE. So the unbuilt combined form-plus-recolor stage is worth 13x the two pure-form directions put together, in BOTH arrows equally, and the direction split is nearly even inside it (47 vs 44). Anyone triaging by direction alone is optimising the small axis.

THE PAYOFF-INVERSION LAW RECURS ONE LEVEL DOWN. claim.LZ_copy-form-taxonomy-and-payoff-inversion.20260901.v1 found that the unconditional class had an empty payoff set and that the census must precede the build. The same thing happened again here at the next level of resolution: the pure inverse direction this lane was ordered to build has TWO sites image-wide, in fn_8001267C and game/pb/dbgtext::fn_800C03E0, and ZERO functions carrying an inverse site have `other == 0`. Building it and stopping would have shipped a rule with a payoff of one function. Run the census before the build, every time, and classify by ARROW AND DESTINATION-EQUALITY TOGETHER, never by arrow alone.

THE POSITIONAL CENSUS UNDERCOUNTS BOTH ARROWS, so treat those totals as floors. fn_8001267C's second inverse site (+0x380) does not exist positionally: before its permutation window that offset holds an `extsh`, and the site only becomes a copy/li pair after the words move. A positional scan files it as an ordinary regfield row. Any future hunt for this family must cluster the differing words and classify AFTER the candidate permutation, not before - which also means the 47/44 figures above are lower bounds on the combined-stage population.

DCSHANDLEREQUEST IS NOT UNBLOCKED BY THIS, RE-MEASURED AFTER THE BUILD, NOT ASSUMED. The direction bar (DC's BAR 2) is gone; the function still refuses. At +0x1e0 the positional pair is ours `li r31,0` against the target's `li r28,0` - li against li, an IMMEDIATE difference webfrank must never close - and all three proof labels including the new inverse one are refused with `target word 0x3b800000 is not a register copy`. +0x1e0 is confirmed a jumptable case-entry (19 targets on the object) and prove_constant_source refuses independently with `+0x1e0 is a branch target: control can enter between the definition and the rewrite site`. DC's park stands on three of its four original bars.
